claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Moracizine is a phenothiazine sodium-channel blocker with weak, micromolar off-target activity at muscarinic, adrenergic, histamine, and calcium-channel sites; at 2.5 uM it is expected to produce little or no selective cancer-cell killing, with any effect likely reflecting nonspecific cationic amphiphilic/lysosomotropic membrane perturbation rather than a targeted anticancer mechanism.
